claims_not_supported: this is a semantics registration, not an optimizer qualification or a shape update
no absolute, grid-independent, high-Re or full-vehicle downforce claim
claims_supported: the SDF-native volume contract is registered with its limit equal to the re-measured genesis contract volume
the recorded handoff cell-material volume and the measured node-occupancy diagnostic are distinct samplings and were not conflated with the contract measure

contract.differentiability: not claimed; a smoothed H_eps volume would be a separate later contract
contract.discretization: one sampled center per h-cube; zero-level values are not solid

stage_t_density_volume.role: Stage T diagnostic and Stage S entry fidelity observable only; not an SDF-native constraint

contract.volume_definition: V_phi = |{h-cubes with trilinear centre sample < 0}| * h^3 (the sharp limit of integral H_eps(-phi) under center sampling)
contract.volume_limit_source: re-measured voxel-equivalent sharp volume of the registered v16 genesis state (1009 sampled solid centers)

claims_not_supported: voxel-equivalent volume is not a differentiable constraint until its H_eps gradient contract is registered
no sub-voxel geometry sensitivity; any sub-voxel volume change between states with equal sampled-center counts is invisible

node_occupancy_diagnostic.role: non-contracted diagnostic; never compare against V_phi limits

measured.volume_definition: V_phi = |{h-cubes with trilinear centre sample < 0}| * h^3 (the sharp limit of integral H_eps(-phi) under center sampling)
